courseName: [OHS 101 ALL SECTIONS] Occupational Health and Safety-I
title: Week 12
name: Chapter 12 (December 14 - December 20, 2026)
content:
We will cover "Traffic Safety" topic.

The level of detail of this chapter are below.

- Definitions of traffic and traffic accidents

- National and international traffic accident data

- Traffic Safety in the World and in Turkey

- Traffic System with its components

- Human factors in driving

- 7E's in road safety

- Traffic Safety at METU

- Conclusions and implications
